messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT detected - elevated 500/502 errors across API edge. Alert source: edge-telemetry. Severity: P1. Paging @evan-oncall and @maria.

maria: seeing a spike in TLS handshake failures and DNS resolution errors in multiple regions (us-west, eu-central). Customers report intermittent 502s.

lee: confirmed. Quick check: hitting our API via Cloudflare edge returns `curl: (35) error:14094410:SSL routines:ssl3_read_bytes:tlsv1 alert handshake failure` in some locations.

jamal: traceroute shows hops stopping at Cloudflare edge nodes for affected regions. Likely upstream CDN/DNS issue, not our app.

sophia: Cloudflare status shows degraded DNS propagation and edge routing issues in EU/US-WEST. https://www.cloudflarestatus.com/ incidents/xxxxx

ana-support: Support queue just lit up. Customers complaining: inability to reach API, some saw TLS errors in client logs. CS notified top 10 affected accounts.

maria: mitigation plan: (1) verify fallback origin routing (2) flip DNS to secondary provider for critical endpoints (3) push temporary client notice via API response headers / status page. Who can execute DNS change?

evan-oncall: I can authorize DNS failover. Jamal/Lee — can you prepare the entries? We'll only flip for api.redwood.ai and analytics endpoints.

jamal: prepping scripts. Proposed TTL reduction before switch: `dig api.redwood.ai @8.8.8.8` shows 300s. I'll set TTL to 60s, then update NS to secondary.

lee: adding curl check loop to validate once NS change is in place:
```
for i in 1 2 3 4 5; do dig +short api.redwood.ai @1.1.1.1; curl -v https://api.redwood.ai/health || echo fail; sleep 10; done
```

incident-bot: @evan-oncall acknowledged the page at 1745224807.

evan-oncall: doing TTL reduction now.

maria: quick note — we should avoid mass key rotations. Keep TLS certs; issue is handshake at edge, certs validated at origin fine.

jamal: TTL set to 60s. Ready to switch NS to our standby provider (ns1-secondary). I'll wait for go-ahead.

sophia: I'll update status page and post interim message about degraded reachability and TLS errors. Draft: "We are investigating reachability issues affecting a subset of Cloudflare edge nodes. Mitigation in progress; customers may see intermittent 502/TLS handshake failures."

ana-support: pinging top affected customers with inc-12345 template. Adding engineering contact for private updates.

evan-oncall: GO for NS change. Jamal, proceed. I'll monitor metrics and rollback if anything odd.

jamal: NS switch initiated. Propagation in progress.

lee: seeing mixed results. us-west checks now mostly resolving to secondary. curl health OK from my laptop in us-west. eu-central still flapping.

sophia: status updated. Added note about mitigation and ETA 15m for propagation.

maria: good. start routing a small percent of traffic via secondary path by updating smart-routing policy to prefer non-cloudflare for canary customer group (50 requests / min) — keeping majority on primary to observe.

jamal: canary traffic flowing to secondary, initial latencies slightly higher but successful TLS handshakes. No 502s observed for canary.

evan-oncall: increasing to 20% traffic for more confidence.

incident-bot: New log spikes: error rate down from 18% -> 7% after NS switch/canary routing.

ana-support: customer reports improving, TLS errors gone for two major accounts. Continuing outreach.

maria: coordinate with Cloudflare account engineer via support ticket and our status channel. Need root cause postmortem: was it BGP/edge config or internal auth with Cloudflare? Cloudflare-status-bot, any updates? 

cloudflare-status-bot: Cloudflare status update: "Investigating an edge routing anomaly impacting TLS handshakes for a subset of POPs. Engineers engaged. More info to follow." (link)

lee: we should keep DNS failover for next 30-60 minutes until CF confirms resolution and stabilizes.

evan-oncall: Agreed. Keep canary expansion paused. I'll start drafting incident bridge notes for Handoff to morning on-call shift.

sophia: Incident bridge scheduled in 10m. Please add logs and curl outputs to the incident doc in /confluence/incidents/1745224800.

maria: action items: 1) maintain NS failover, 2) monitor error rates and TLS handshake errors, 3) coordinate with CF eng, 4) CS customer updates every 15m. Assigning owners: Jamal (DNS ops), Evan (oncall lead), Sophia (comms), Ana (support comms), Lee (telemetry).

ana-support: capture affected customer list and any contractual SLA impacts. Escalating to AMs where needed.

jamal: rolling back NS switch is ready if Cloudflare indicates fix; will wait for explicit go-ahead.

evan-oncall: logging final note before handoff — current status: partial mitigation in place; majority of traffic healthy; monitoring for 30m. Handoff to @maria at 1745224905.

maria: taking over. Thanks team. I'll keep this thread updated and will open a postmortem once incident resolved. :thumbsup:
